mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) compresses real equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior two months indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the retail sales growth rate (RSAFS) exceeds 0.5% monthly, it signals strong consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS growth rate > 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strengthening economy that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 expands, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1.0% monthly, it indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profitability, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 1.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
